purpose: Define the minimum execution-resolved chronological portfolio representation required before drawdown, volatility, turnover or annualized performance metrics may be treated as meaningful.
design_principle: The evaluator measures a supplied executed portfolio path. It does not invent holding periods, fill prices, position sizing, overlapping-signal allocation, leverage, shorting, slippage, limit-up/limit-down behavior or transaction-cost assumptions.

delete: No event-row-to-portfolio conversion inside the validity evaluator.
No inferred treatment of untradable orders.
reuse: Existing temporal/vintage, OOS and authorization boundaries remain binding.
Existing Strategy Validity foundation consumes portfolio-path outputs only after an upstream research design explicitly authorizes the required return data.

field_semantics.date: Chronological portfolio-return interval label. Dates must be unique at the daily aggregation layer after security rows are grouped.
field_semantics.exposure_weight: Executed exposure applied to security_return for this exact interval. It is not a target weight and not an order request.
field_semantics.security_return: Authorized realized return for the same interval and price/vintage convention as the executed exposure.
field_semantics.transaction_cost: Non-negative portfolio-fraction cost attributable to this security/date interval, already incorporating the upstream frozen commission/slippage/tax model.
field_semantics.benchmark_return: Optional daily benchmark return. If supplied on multiple security rows for one date it must be identical within that date.
field_semantics.sample_partition: Optional upstream-frozen train/OOS label. The evaluator does not assign partitions.
field_semantics.regime: Optional upstream-supplied regime label. The evaluator does not infer regimes.
field_semantics.execution_status: Optional descriptive upstream execution label; no fill logic is inferred from it.

annualization.rule: CAGR, annualized volatility and Sharpe-like metrics are forbidden unless periods_per_year is explicitly supplied by the frozen experiment registration.
annualization.rule_risk_free: No zero-risk-free assumption is implicit. Any annualized Sharpe-like metric requires an explicit per-period risk-free input or an explicit registered choice of zero.

integrity_rules: Required fields may not be null or non-numeric where numeric semantics apply.
security_return must be > -1.0 for multiplicative equity computation.
A date/security pair must be unique.
benchmark_return, sample_partition and regime must not conflict within one date when supplied.
No price or return access is authorized by this contract itself.
No fold3/fold4 access is authorized by this contract itself.
No setup/live/trade execution is authorized by this contract itself.
explicit_non_goals: Does not decide whether an unfilled order should be carried forward.
Does not choose transaction-cost or slippage parameters.
Does not classify strategy evidence strength.
